integrity: A constructive all-parameter facet and elementary-collapse proof is accompanied by an exact integral Mayer-Vietoris module calculation and 224 independently replayed collapse pairs plus 1,388 signed-character comparisons on finite instances. Experiments corroborate but do not prove universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: The statement concerns full strong discrete Morse matching complexes of finite one-dimensional complete bipartite graphs with both part sizes at least three. The two-vertex-part case was already known and is not claimed as new. The explicit simplicial collapse need not respect graph automorphisms; the integral homology module is obtained separately. The defining primary source was only partially readable in this run, so there is residual literature risk. Independent review has not been performed.
title: Strong Morse complexes of complete bipartite graphs with two large parts
